utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up momentum. I can swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good. I’ll be around after your errands, and we can go through the list together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll check in after I’m done and we can sort the list together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. What’s left on your end?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I still need to grab the last batch and label the boxes.}

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I can take the boxes if you label the batch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive starts today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think it starts today, but I’d want to double-check the timing and where everyone’s meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but we still need to confirm the time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to ask Cleo about that earlier, but I lost track - what's the next thing I should bring by?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bring the white duct tape and a Phillips screwdriver if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll bring the white duct tape and a Phillips screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, what exactly do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mostly tools and whatever parts I can carry. I’m trying to get the drive sorted, not start a whole project.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just the tools and parts, then. I can help if you tell me what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, what’s left for me to do on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — the last batch is sorting and hauling the broken boards. If you grab a pair of work gloves, I’ll point you to the stack by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll grab gloves and head to the stack by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a pile of loose trim and a stubborn hinge that need attention first. I can hand you the tools and point you at the worst spots.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, point me to the hinge and I’ll start with that, then I can tackle the trim.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the location if you tell me where the repair drive is headed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s headed to the community center on Maple, right after school. I’ll make sure you get the exact time too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll wait for the exact time and head to the community center on Maple after school.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up nicely — folks around here have been dropping off tools and spare parts all morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll head over and spread the word — sounds like the kind of thing everyone should pitch in on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Glad to hear it — I’ll keep passing it along, and maybe we’ll get the whole block to chip in before the day’s out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, is the repair drive still on? I can help if you need another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it’s still on. I could use another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll head over and help out. What do you want me to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep on it and let Nell know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, let me know when you have the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll have the plan soon and I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll organize the repair drive list and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. I’ll add my part when I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive's still moving along, but a few folks are waiting on parts. I heard there should be an update by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll check back this afternoon and see what the update is.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, I’ll let you know what I hear later this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late - what part of the repair drive do you need me on?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I need you on cleanup and sorting the donated parts table. I’ll point you at the big stuff once you’re here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll start with cleanup and the parts table, then wait for you to point me at the bigger stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you want. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the wiring on the north side. I can show you where it’s failing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Show me where it’s failing, and I’ll take a look with you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, could you meet me by the repair drive entrance?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll be there by the entrance soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around and help connect folks if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d help. Can you check who’s actually available before you start?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I’ll check who can actually make it first, then I’ll pass along the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to check on that earlier, but I got sidetracked. How bad is it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s pretty bad, honestly, but not hopeless. A few things are still broken, and I’m hoping we can get enough hands to knock it out this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along, but I haven't gotten the details yet. I'll check back once I know more.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to hear. If you get the details, send them my way and I can lend a hand if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do. I’ll send the details your way once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I need a hand moving the parts and one extra set of tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll bring the tools and help move the parts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should make sure the repair drive has a clear time and place, or people will show up at the wrong house.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right, when and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s meet at the community center at 10 a.m., so there’s one clear place for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is getting organized fast, so I’m spreading the word now. Want me to put your name on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Put me on it. I can bring tape and a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll add you to the list. Bring the tape and screws, and I’ll make sure everyone knows you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to know what time it starts so I can work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right - I think we were aiming for after pickup, maybe around 4:30. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 4:30 should work for me after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell — I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’ll make sure we keep it moving.
